name: [🚨UPDATE] Printer Game
desc:
💸 Welcome to Printer Game! 💸
Start with a humble Rusty Printer and work your way up to powerful machines like the Quantum and Fusion Printers. Build your base, protect your printers, raid others, and dominate the economy.

Join the group for increased income! 1.2x

Printer Game is all about:
    •    💰 Generating income and upgrading your printers
    •    🔫 Buying weapons, bombs, and equipment to raid or defend
    •    💥 Risk vs reward – printers can explode or be stolen if left unguarded!

🌟 Want to help improve the game? Post in #suggestions on our community server or group page!

🛒 Shops:
    •    Ammo Alley – Guns & Gear
    •    WKIES Supply – Equipment
    •    CMDRS Bomb Store – Bombs


⚙️ Controls:
    •    Press C to crouch
    •    Use printers wisely – protect your investment!

📜 Disclaimer:
We reserve the right to ban or restrict access to this game if you break Roblox’s Terms of Use or our rules.
